questions.question: What is the SI unit of pressure?
questions.explanation: The SI unit of pressure is Pascal (Pa).

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: A ball is dropped from height h. What is its velocity just before hitting ground?
questions.explanation: Using v² = u² + 2as: v² = 0 + 2gh, so v = √(2gh).

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: What is the work-energy theorem?
questions.explanation: Work-energy theorem states that net work done equals change in kinetic energy.
